RLC Enhancer installs these files unchanged in "Documents\RL Career Hub Mod\presets"
and adds the RLCareerLiveries hook to the modded copy's resources\rlbot\start_match.py,
so every bot of a career match uses one of its pro player's real presets.
Settings: config.json in that folder (reinstalling keeps it).
